title: Normalized integral compact-support compositor component
statement: For one integral constructible input, the proper/open construction and refinement normalization specify a unique isomorphism between the nested and composite compact-support values.

proof.text: Construct a tower refining all three supplied compactifications. Densely compactify cf.g followed by cg.i; properness makes its square cartesian. Precompose by cf.i, then take the common refinement with a tower dominating cfg. The pullback universal map supplies the refinement to cf, the outer refinement is identity on cg, and the two ambient proper maps give the refinement to cfg.

For this tower use the completed local invertibility and normalized refinement existence lemmas. The completed image of e.restrict K is constructible by the qcqs realization and closure under isomorphism. Compose the three refinement factors with the tower map, transport by the fixed source and target realization isomorphisms, and lift the result through the full-subcategory inclusion.

On an arbitrary refining tower obtain its local witnesses by the same lemmas. The conditional tower-independence equality identifies its conjugated arrow with the one constructed on the selected tower, proving SfIntegralCompositionComponentSpec. Conversely any normalized component has this same underlying arrow by applying independence to its witnesses on the selected tower. Faithfulness of the full-subcategory inclusion and Iso.ext imply uniqueness.
